readiness.standby_step: This server is a standby: run the statements on its primary, they reach the standby by replication.
readiness.step.connect_each_dba: Connect to each monitored database as a DBA (pglens never creates extensions).
readiness.step.restart_pg_at_start: Restart PostgreSQL: the setting is read at start.
readiness.ext01.title: pg_stat_statements is not enabled
readiness.ext01.summary: The server does not load or create pg_stat_statements, so there are no per-statement statistics.
readiness.ext01.evidence.extension: no monitored database lists the pg_stat_statements extension
readiness.ext01.preload.title: Preload the library
readiness.ext01.preload.step: Add pg_stat_statements to shared_preload_libraries in postgresql.conf (keep the libraries already listed).
readiness.ext01.create.title: Create the extension in each monitored database
readiness.set01.title: compute_query_id is off
readiness.set01.summary: Without a query identifier an active session cannot be matched to its statement.
readiness.set01.impact.link: Link between active sessions and statements
readiness.set01.fix.title: Let PostgreSQL compute the identifier
readiness.set01.fix.step1: Set compute_query_id to auto (or on) in postgresql.conf.
readiness.set01.fix.step2: Reload the configuration (SELECT pg_reload_conf();): no restart is needed.
readiness.set02.title: track_io_timing is off
readiness.set02.summary: PostgreSQL does not time block reads and writes.
readiness.set02.sql.title: Turn it on without a restart
readiness.set02.sql.step1: Run the statements below as a superuser (or the managed service's equivalent parameter group change).
readiness.set02.command.title: Change the server start command
readiness.set02.command.step1: track_io_timing is set on the server command line, which ALTER SYSTEM cannot override.
readiness.set02.command.step2: Change the start command (for a container, the command: line of the compose file) to pass -c track_io_timing=on.
readiness.role01.title: The monitoring role lacks predefined roles
readiness.role01.summary: The role cannot see other users' sessions and statements, nor every setting.
readiness.role01.evidence: the monitoring role is not a member of {roles}
readiness.role01.fix.title: Grant the missing membership
readiness.role01.fix.step: Run the statements below as a superuser, or run deploy/sql/monitoring_user.sql as documented in deploy/sql/README.md.
readiness.host01.title: The host filesystem is not measured
readiness.host01.summary: The agent runs next to this server but cannot read its data directory.
readiness.host01.impact: Host filesystem total and free charts
readiness.host01.evidence.unreadable: the agent could not read the data directory's filesystem
readiness.host01.evidence.no_sample: no host_disk_* sample in the last {minutes} minutes
readiness.host01.fix.title: Mount the data directory read-only into the agent
readiness.host01.fix.step: Mount the PostgreSQL data directory into the agent container read-only, at the same path as on the server.
readiness.chk01.title: A check is failing
readiness.chk01.summary: The agent reports errors for at least one check, so its data is missing or old.
readiness.chk01.fix.title: Read the agent's error
readiness.chk01.fix.step1: Open Findings and read the entry of the failing check; the agent log has the full error.
readiness.chk01.fix.step2: Fix the cause it names (a missing privilege or extension is the usual one), then wait one collection interval.
readiness.chk02.title: A check is skipped
readiness.chk02.summary: The agent does not run a check on this server for a reason that can be fixed.
readiness.chk02.extension.title: Create the {extension} extension
readiness.chk02.generic.title: Find why the agent skips the check
readiness.chk02.generic.step1: Search the agent log for the check name: the line says what the agent found missing.
readiness.chk02.generic.step2: Give the monitoring role what the check needs (a predefined role, a privilege or an extension), then wait one collection interval.
readiness.act01.title: Per-application activity is off
readiness.act01.summary: The agent does not count connections per application.
readiness.act01.evidence: checks.activity.by_application is false in the agent configuration
readiness.act01.fix.title: Turn it on in agent.yaml
readiness.act01.fix.step: Set the key below in agent.yaml.
readiness.db01.title: Some databases are not monitored
readiness.db01.summary: The agent found more databases than its budget lets it monitor.
readiness.db01.impact: Databases beyond the budget are not analysed
readiness.db01.fix.title: Raise the per-target database budget
readiness.db01.fix.step: Raise databases.max of the target in agent.yaml to at least the number of databases found, or narrow the list with include and exclude.
readiness.notif01.title: No notification channel is configured
readiness.notif01.summary: Alerts are raised but nothing delivers them.
readiness.notif01.console.title: Add a channel in the console
readiness.notif01.console.step: Open Settings, Notifications, and add a channel.
readiness.notif01.env.title: Configure it in the server environment
readiness.notif01.env.step: Set the notification variables of the server as documented in the README, then restart the server.
readiness.t201.title: The monitoring role cannot signal other sessions
readiness.t201.summary: Tier 2 is the pg_signal_backend grant. Cancel and terminate also need allow_signal in the agent configuration.
readiness.t201.impact: Cancel and terminate of other sessions from the console
readiness.t201.fix.title: Grant tier 2
readiness.t201.fix.step: Run the statements below as a superuser, or run deploy/sql/monitoring_user.sql with tier1=1 and tier2=1 as documented in deploy/sql/README.md.
readiness.ext02.title: pgstattuple is not installed
readiness.ext02.summary: Exact bloat measurement on demand needs the pgstattuple extension.
readiness.ext02.impact: Exact bloat on demand (the pgstattuple command)
readiness.ext02.fix.title: Create the extension
readiness.ext02.fix.step: Connect to the database as a DBA (pglens never creates extensions).
readiness.cmd01.title: On-demand commands are off
readiness.cmd01.summary: The agent does not poll the server for commands.
readiness.cmd01.evidence: commands.enabled is false in the agent configuration
readiness.cmd01.fix.title: Turn commands on
readiness.cmd01.fix.step: Set the key below in agent.yaml (the default is on).
readiness.sig01.title: Cancel and terminate are off (by design)
readiness.sig01.summary: allow_signal is off by default: the agent never signals another session unless you turn it on for the target.
readiness.sig01.evidence: allow_signal is false for this target
readiness.sig01.fix.title: Allow signals for the target
readiness.sig01.fix.step: Needs tier 2 (see RDY-T2-01). Set the key below on the target in agent.yaml.
readiness.sess01.title: Raw text of active sessions is off
readiness.sess01.summary: The console shows the normalised text of active sessions, not the raw text.
readiness.sess01.impact: Raw text of active sessions (normalised text is still shown)
readiness.sess01.fix.title: Collect the raw text
readiness.sess01.fix.step1: Raw text may contain literal values such as names or identifiers: turn it on only if that is acceptable.
readiness.sess01.fix.step2: Set the key below in agent.yaml, then restart the agent.
readiness.set03.title: Long statements are cut in activity
readiness.set03.summary: track_activity_query_size is below 4096 bytes, so long statements are truncated.
readiness.set03.impact: Full text of long statements in activity
readiness.set03.fix.title: Raise the size
readiness.set03.fix.step: Set the value below in postgresql.conf.
readiness.log01.title: PostgreSQL log reading is limited
readiness.log01.summary: The agent's log reader (checks.logs) reports a note: some log lines are not read or not classified as they should be.
readiness.log01.impact.other: The log reader reports the note {note}.
readiness.log01.step.connect: Connect to the server as a superuser.
readiness.log01.logs_no_structured_forma: No log line is read: the server writes no jsonlog or csvlog file.
Write the log as jsonlog (PostgreSQL 15 or later) or csvlog
readiness.log01.logs_sql_denied.impact: No log line is read: the monitoring role may not read the log through SQL.
readiness.log01.logs_sql_denied.fix: Let the monitoring role read the log file
readiness.log01.logs_file_unreadable.imp: No log line is read: the agent cannot open the log file on this host.
readiness.log01.logs_file_unreadable.fix: Give the agent the log file, or read it through SQL
readiness.log01.logs_file_unreadable.ste: Run the agent on the database host as a user that may read the log directory, or
set checks.logs.source: sql in the agent configuration and restart the agent.
readiness.log01.logs_messages_not_englis: Lines classified by their message text (checkpoints, autovacuum, slow statements, temporary files) are missed: lc_messages is not English.
Write the server messages in English
readiness.log01.logs_timezone_unknown.im: Log times may be shifted: the agent cannot read log_timezone.
readiness.log01.logs_timezone_unknown.fi: Let the monitoring role read the server settings
readiness.aex01.title: Automatic plans are not in JSON
readiness.aex01.summary: auto_explain writes plans in a format the agent cannot read: only auto_explain.log_format = json is stored.
readiness.aex01.impact: Automatic plans and their samples in the plan history are missing.
